summary: Assemble output includes structured markdown briefing and inline status summary
context: Agents don't reliably act on raw JSON assemble output. Agents also waste turns calling both status and assemble at session start. num_turns correlates strongly with cost (r=0.75) without quality gain.
rationale: formatForLLM() produces imperative markdown sections (decisions to respect, warnings, continue from, quick reference) optimized for LLM consumption. assembleWithStatus() merges status summary into the assemble call, eliminating a separate tool call. Both changes reduce turns and improve information utilization.

alternatives.option: Return markdown only without JSON data
alternatives.reason_rejected: Tests and programmatic consumers depend on the JSON structure; breaking backward compatibility would be disruptive

alternatives.option: Keep raw JSON output and rely on agent instructions to parse it
alternatives.reason_rejected: Benchmark showed agents don't reliably act on unstructured JSON dumps
